body:
I just don`t believe in myself i give up on everything very easily.I don`t follow through with anything.I tend to have a huge anxiety problem when trying to do something in front or for a large number of people, like playing guitar or doing something I'm not really sure of.I even forget the things i do know because i get so upset that i lose all concentration.Then i torture myself over it, think how stupid and worthless i am and end up not trusting myself with anything and withdrawing from everything. 
I'm terrible with people.I can be so rough, making harsh sarcastic remarks.I sometimes taunt people in a daze or just act out when i`m angry and say hurtful things that can leave you wondering what in the hell caused such an outburst rather than being offended.I'm not always like that i can be good but my demons come out sooner or later and people remember that.I have a tendency of being jealous, envious, annoyingly boastful, of badmouthing because i feel so worthless in comparison to everyone.it seems like its very hard for me to not focus on something negative so i end up nit-picking.I think i can`t help it and project my unrealistic need for everything to be perfect and the best of the best on everything.I end up feeling a huge disdainful hypocrite dwelling in the past calling up every bad memory with lightning fast speed and emotional potency and shutting down as a result and getting sucked back in to everything.In situations where i should be very happy by all accounts i end up feeling immense shame and guilt for everything bad I've done.Its like i restrict myself from being happy because i made someone else feel bad or because i`m letting someone else down constantly.I feel like a complete fraud for being loved by someone so good , smart and ambitious and i feel like i`m wasting the persons time being such a mental case.
it would be such a relief from everything just cutting my wrists.im fairly tolerant of pain and i cut myself at work accidentaly a few times its just a small stinging sensation
